question_text: How many events on 2025-12-08 (UTC) had a detection confidence below 0.85?

gold.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS low_conf FROM events WHERE confidence < 0.85 AND timestamp_utc >= '2025-12-08T00:00:00Z' AND timestamp_utc < '2025-12-09T00:00:00Z'

metadata.note: Threshold-filter COUNT — tests handling of a numeric inequality on the confidence column.
